THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON(1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labourwhich accompanies this order exists between,
Mr. W. A. Wijedasa, “Nilmini Niwasa”, Nagolla, Kuttiyagolla, Badulla.of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Act, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. M. E. G. Samaraweera, No. 123/6, Old Kandy Road, Dalugama, Kelaniya to be the arbitratorand refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo,07th October, 2019.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE EN ACTMENTS OF CEYLON(1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. W. A. Wijedasa, “Nilmini Niwasa”, Nagolla, Kuttiyagolla, Badulla.of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. W. A. Wijedasa of the Sri Lanka Transport Board who had been retired on 05.10.2013 at the completion of 57 yearsof age and reinstated in service with effect from 24.04.2015 had been caused injustice by the non-payment of salaries for theperiod from 05.10.2013 to 24.04.2015 and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, this 17th day of September, 2019.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments ofCeylon (Revised Edition 1956), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with IndustrialDisputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 02.09.2016 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 1983/39 dated 09.09.2016 of the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specifiedin the statement of the Commissioner of Labour dated 18.07.2016.
Mr. Senaka Maithri de Livera, No. 639/6, Gunawardhana Mawatha, Pita Kotte, Kotte.
and
Royal Colombo Golf Club, No. 223, Model Farm Road, Colombo 08.
was referred to Mr. P. Nawaratne for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour andTrade Union Relations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the saidOrder dated 02.09.2016.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.07th October, 2019.
